svg.aria-label: Left: the plane of the far corner (A, B), with the part A, B at least one half of the disk of radius R0 shaded; its corner (rho0 + 1/2, 1/2) lies on the circle in the direction theta. For the direction s = 0.12, blue, the dashed line perpendicular to it through the corner keeps the shaded part on one side; for s = 0.6, orange, the dashed tangent at the point of the circle in that direction does. Right: the two squares turned by these angles that reach deepest into a cap: the blue one with both corners of its far edge on the circle, the orange one with its far vertex on the circle on the axis; each touches its dashed line x = cap(s) with a vertex
